description:
Implement BUILDPLAN Amendment 12 / milestone M-65: the complete cold start, one vertical slice in walkthrough order. This ticket owns EVALUATION §2.4 (AC-275 – AC-287) via a claims manifest at tests/ac-claims/MRQ-105.json — landing that manifest is what turns the band's trace:ac enforcement on, so it ships in this PR together with the tests.

READ FIRST, in order: (1) BUILDPLAN.md Amendment 12 — the scope table and boundaries; (2) EVALUATION.md §2.4 — the thirteen ACs with their exact verification shapes; (3) SPEC.md Amendment 19 — schema deltas (magic_links purposes claim|org_invite with nullable person_id), route table, CLI verbs, §5 screen deltas; (4) sequence/USER_STORIES.md Amendment 19 (US-83 – US-86); (5) prototypes/cold-start/DECISIONS.md (rulings D1–D8) and prototypes/cold-start/SKILL-SETUP-CHAPTER.md (the agent-side contract to fold into cli/generate-skill.mjs renderSkill()); (6) docs/GETTING-STARTED.md (human-side contract; AC-287 removes its status banner and the README caveat IN THIS PR); (7) the cold-start flow in prototypes/pipeline-v1.1/index.html v1.11 — the binding markup for the unclaimed landing, claim, handoff, Instance panel, organizers card, and conference-scoped checklist.

SCOPE, in build order: migration widening magic_links; claim-link CLI verb + /claim/:token page + POST /api/v1/claim; unclaimed landing (renders ONLY when zero owner memberships exist — the seeded demo has one, so the deployed judged site must render byte-identically; hard guard, not a hope); post-claim scoped-token offer (ordinary api_tokens row, no new kind); POST /api/v1/events + /conferences/new UI + switcher ＋; org invites mint/exchange/revoke + organizer list/removal (sessions revoked in-transaction; last owner cannot self-remove); GET /api/v1/instance/status derived from real binding/secret presence + Instance panel + the AC-285 publish acknowledgment (warn-and-record, never hard-block); POST /api/v1/admin/remove-demo (is_demo scope only, idempotent); CLI setup verbs + SKILL setup chapter through renderSkill() (byte-equality test binding — reconcile verb names with what MRQ-104 already shipped before minting new ones); AC-287 docs-truth static scan.

BOUNDARIES: package.json untouched (no new dependencies). Suite budget 45 s objective — prefer tests/node for pure logic; each new Worker-backed integration file costs ~19 s, so consolidate into as few files as the ACs allow. Test titles are "AC-nnn · description" (trace:ac parses them). check:api registry/OpenAPI parity applies to every new route.

PROCESS: work in a fresh worktree off github/main (Marquee-worktrees/mrq-105), never the main checkout; commit early and often; PR via gh pr create --repo Stage-11-Agentics/marquee --base main. DO NOT MERGE — merging is human-gated, and this ticket is post-deadline scope that must not merge before the competition freeze clears (BUILDPLAN Amendment 12). When the PR is open and green, set this task to review and flag your surface.
title: Cold start: from git clone to an owned conference — claim link, POST /events, invites, honest instance (M-65, AC-275–AC-287)
